## Quality Checklist (for reviewers)

- [ ] Problem is clearly stated and justified
- [ ] Success criteria are testable (not vague)
- [ ] Scope boundaries are explicit
- [ ] Requirements are traceable to success criteria
- [ ] No implementation details leaked into spec (that's the design doc's job)
- [ ] Open questions are identified (not hidden)
